name: Apache Pulsar
summary: Consume messages from and produce messages to Apache Pulsar topics, with token authentication, as JSON lines in a workflow.

fields.name: auth_token
fields.label: Authentication token
fields.help: A JWT issued by the cluster's operator; store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: service_url
settings.label: Service URL
settings.help: pulsar:// for plain text, pulsar+ssl:// for TLS.

egress.note: The host in service_url. 6650 is the default for pulsar://, 6651 for pulsar+ssl://.

operators.summary: Read messages from a topic through a subscription and keep them as JSON lines.
Send messages to a topic and record the message id of each.

notes: Bridging messages into Ogun's stream sources (O-09) is done by ogun-ingest and is not built for Pulsar.
